Description:
As a policyholder, I want to select an eligible policy so that I can register against the correct cover.
Given two eligible policies, when the policy step opens, then both are selectable and expired policies are excluded.

As a policyholder, I want to enter my incident date so that I can identify when the loss occurred.
Given a future incident date, when the policyholder continues, then an inline error appears and the submission remains a draft.

As a policyholder, I want to submit my incident details so that I can receive a claim reference.
Given valid incident details and an eligible policy, when the policyholder submits, then one claim is recorded and a reference is displayed.
As a policyholder, I want to upload one supporting photo so that I can show damage.
As a policyholder, I want to replace a rejected photo so that I can correct my evidence.
As a policyholder, I want to download an upload receipt so that I can retain proof of submission.
As a policyholder, I want to see my claim status so that I can understand progress.

Summary: See the last status change date
Description: As a policyholder, I want to see the last status change date so that I can know when it moved.
As a policyholder, I want to see outstanding actions so that I can respond to requests.
As a policyholder, I want to receive a settlement email so that I can learn when payment is approved.

Summary: See the settlement amount in the portal
Description: As a policyholder, I want to see the settlement amount in the portal so that I can verify the payment.
As a policyholder, I want to manage my notification preferences so that I can control optional alerts.
